1. Mr. Vinodanand Barthwal, learned counsel for
petitioner.
2. Mr. J.C. Pande, learned Standing Counsel for
State of Uttarakhand.
3. I n this Writ Petition, filed in Public I nterest,
petitioner has raised the issue of change of alignment
of the road, which was under construction. As per the
original alignment, the road was to pass through
Amaratva Primary School. However, as per the revised
alignment, the school would be left out. This,
according to petitioner, was done for extraneous/
political reasons.
4. We asked learned State Counsel to get
instructions. Learned State Counsel has produced in
Court written instructions received from District
Magistrate, Rudraprayag, which are taken on record.
5. District Magistrate, Rudraprayag, in his
instructions, has stated that alignment of the road was
changed, as the road, as originally proposed, would
pass through landslide prone area, which would have
endangered the lives of the persons using the said
road. Therefore, on the request made by Gram
Pradhan, Gram Sabha Mayali, the alignment of the
road has been changed.
6. Learned State Counsel submits that hill cutting
work of the road, as per the revised alignment, has
been complete, and now the second phase of the road

construction has to be done.
7. Since, hill cutting work of the road is complete,
therefore, any interference in the matter, at this stage,
would be against public interest. Even otherwise also,
the alignment of road, that too in hills, has to be
decided by domain experts, as a number of aspects
have to be taken into account before taking any
decision in the matter. I n the absence of necessary
experience in the matter, this Court is not inclined to
interfere with the decision taken by domain experts. I n
such view of the matter, we refuse to interfere in the
matter.
8. The Writ Petition is, therefore, dismissed.
9. However, petitioner shall be at liberty to
approach the competent authority, with a request to
connect his road by constructing a road to the nearest
motor road. I f petitioner makes such representation to
District Magistrate, Rudraprayag, decision thereupon
shall be taken within eight weeks from date of receipt
of representation, along with certified copy of this
order.
10. Consequently, pending application(s), if any, also
stand disposed of.
 ( Viv ek Bh ar t i Sh ar m a, J.) ( Man o j Ku m ar Tiw ar i, A.C.J.)
